main_text.p: Pinguis Bu̇bicio discessit vomere sulcus: Leleges popi Mox Lelegum dextra pressum descendit aratrum. Dolopes po. Æolidæ, Dolopésque solum fregere coloni, Minyæ pop. Et Magnetes equis, Minyæ gens cognita remis. Centauri. Illic semiferos Ixionidas Centauros Pelethronij populi. Fœta Pelethronijs nubes effudit in antris: Pholoe mõs. Aspera te Pholoes frangentem Moniche saxa, Teque sub Ætneo torquentem vertice vulsas Rhoete ferox, quas vix Boreas inuerteret, ornos: Hospes & Alcidæ magni Phole: teque per amnem Improbe Lernæas victor passure sagittas: Teque senex Chiron gelido qui sidere fulgens Impetis Æmonio maiorem Scorpion arcu. Hac tellure feri micuerunt semina Martis. Prima inuen ta Thessalo- tum. Primus ab aquorea percussis cuspide saxis Thessalicus sonipes, bellis feralibus omen Exiluit: primus Chalyben, franosque momordit, Lapithæ po. Spumauitque nouis Lapithæ domitoris habenis. Pegasus na- uis. Prima fretum scindens Pegasæo littore pinus, Terrenum ignotas hominem proiecit in vndas. Primus Thessalicæ rector telluris Ionos In formam calidæ percussit pondera massæ, Fudit & argentum flammis, aurúmque moneta Fregit, & immensis coxit fornacibus æra. Illic (quòd populos scelerata impegit in arma) Diuitias numerare datum est: hinc maxima serpens Cyrrha mõs. Descendit Pythona, Cyrrhæaque fluxit in antra: Vnde & Thessalicæ veniunt ad Pythia laurus. Impius hinc prolem superis immisit Alœus, Inseruit celsis prope se cùm Pelion astris, Sideribúsque vias incumbens abstulit Ossa. Tibull.lib.1. Quicquid habet Circe, quicquid Medea veneni, Thessalia ve- neni ferax. Quicquid & herbarum Thessala terra gerit.

page.notes: Marginal notes are reproduced as printed; the printed page-top shows a mirror of the facing page (show-through) which is omitted. Several words are uncertain in the scan due to faded ink and bleed-through, notably "Pinguis Bu̇bicio", "Moniche", "Pelethronijs", "Thessalo-tum" and the corner note words; the verse was read from the scan and may contain errors in the lower margin notes.
